prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one final, polished Korean-language social media feed promotional poster for the Sobrita mobile budgeting app, portrait aspect ratio exactly 4:5, ideally 1536x1920 pixels. This is finished ad artwork with readable text, not a mockup or screenshot.

Primary request: Advertise Sobrita's 2026 Halloween costume gift event, using the actual established costumed pet identities from the three input references. Make this a charming, premium, cozy pixel-art Halloween celebration that people immediately want to share. Use an original composed poster, not an app UI.

Input images:
Image 1: /Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/design/seasonal/2026-halloween-dia-de-muertos/michi-dracula-v1.png — exact hero character identity and costume reference. Michi is a navy-blue tabby kitten with amber eyes, cream muzzle/chest/paws, three cream forehead stripes, one upright ear and one folded ear with a cream star, teal collar and square gold tag, red-lined black Dracula cape, red bow tie and dark vest.
Image 2: /Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/design/seasonal/2026-halloween-dia-de-muertos/guinea-pig-pumpkin-v1.png — exact secondary character identity and costume reference: black-and-white guinea pig, white forehead blaze, amber eyes, pumpkin romper and small pumpkin cap, green leaves, teal collar and gold tag.
Image 3: /Users/jaewook/dev_app/sobra_app/design/seasonal/2026-halloween-dia-de-muertos/maltese-little-ghost-v1.png — exact secondary character identity and costume reference: cream-white Maltese with tied topknot, floppy ears, brown eyes and friendly white ghost hood/cloak, teal ribbon and gold pendant.
These are references for a new composition. Preserve their faces, fur colors, silhouettes and costumes faithfully. Render each of these three characters exactly once, with full paws, ears and tail within frame. Michi is largest and centered; the other two flank him at a slightly smaller scale. The pumpkin character remains a guinea pig, not a hamster, dog or cat.

Scene and composition: Twilight violet and deep indigo Halloween night, a small warmly lit pixel-art room/porch stage with wooden floorboards, little amber lanterns and a few smiling jack-o-lanterns at the outside corners. A softly glowing moon, tiny pixel stars, very subtle bat silhouettes and warm string lights frame the composition. The three pets form a welcoming, eye-catching party group in the central/lower middle portion, gathered near one small teal-and-gold wrapped gift box. Keep clear negative space in the upper quarter for the headline and a calm lower band for the call to action. Decorative props must never touch the letters or cover the faces. Strong hierarchy, generous margins, polished alignment.

Style/medium: Elaborate crisp 2D pixel art consistent with the game-character references, intentional stepped contours and clustered pixels with rich warm shading; cute and affectionate, sophisticated indie-game campaign poster. Clean typesetting on top of the illustration, expertly readable Korean Hangul with complete accurate syllables. Warm cream lettering and pumpkin-orange highlights against the indigo background. Teal and gold accents echo the pets' collars. No photorealism, no smooth vector mascot redesign, no 3D plastic look.

Exact text only, use the following wording verbatim, without quotation marks:
Small brand at top: "Sobrita"
Small brand descriptor just below: "고양이와 함께하는 가계부"
Large main headline, two lines: "할로윈 의상" / "12종 무료 선물"
The second line is a vivid warm orange focal line, with 12 especially prominent.
A small high-contrast rounded date ribbon below headline: "2026.11.03까지 · 수령 후 영구 소장"
A large teal pixel-edged button near the bottom: "앱에서 선물 받기"
A clearly readable small cream footnote below button: "의상은 보유한 캐릭터에게 입힐 수 있어요."

Factual constraints: The free gift is 12 COSTUMES, not free character unlocks. Never write free characters or imply that paid characters are unlocked. The exact final claim date is 2026-11-03. The costumes are permanently retained after claiming. Only depict the three referenced characters; they represent some of the twelve costume types. No price, fake star rating, download statistics, QR code, store logo, fictitious screenshots or extra text. No horror, blood, frightening skeletons or frightening faces. No watermark. Full-bleed opaque background. Deliver only the finished single 4:5 poster.
